_comment: Permissible deviations per guideline interval. Draft values - not the official HPT guideline.
_bands_comment: Interval H is what the tool already ships in flask_app/permissible_deviations.json. Equilibrium and evaluation reuse those bands; there is deliberately no second H table here.
_dtreturn_comment: dtreturn_k is the individual liquid sink INLET half-width in K: dTreturn = T_return_emu - T_return_calc, measured return minus set return. Interval H is +/-0.5 K and equilibrium and evaluation reuse it. The parent Deviations page keeps its own full-cycle band (-2...+2 K) in permissible_deviations.json. An interval without dtreturn_k is shown as n/a, never as 0 %.
_ds_comment: Interval D and S individual half-widths from the draft transient table (air-to-water). Encode only filled cells: a missing key is n/a, never 0. Do not set bands to permissible_deviations - that would score D/S with Interval H.
_mean_comment: mean_* keys are the MEAN half-widths of the draft transient table: one arithmetic mean per interval against its setpoint, not a share of samples. Guideline Windows scores them as H / D / S mean columns (K, or % of set for flow). They are a different quantity from the individual widths above, so H mean DB is +/-0.3 K while H individual DB stays +/-1 K, and they must not be copied onto the parent Deviations page (mean DB there stays 0.6 K). A draft cell that is - or ? has no key here and stays n/a: D has no mean Tsup / flow / inlet, S has no mean Tsup / inlet, and Tmean is undecided on H, D and S.
